title: The Optimal Sample Complexity of Agnostic PAC Learning for Partial Concept Classes
abstract: arXiv:2611.27946v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Let $\mathcal H\subseteq\{-1,+1,\star\}^{\mathcal X}$ be a partial concept class of finite VC dimension $d$. We construct a deterministic agnostic PAC learner that, for every $\varepsilon,\delta\in(0,1)$, uses $O((d+\log(1/\delta))/\varepsilon^2)$ i.i.d. examples from an arbitrary distribution $\mathcal D$ over $\mathcal X\times\{-1,+1\}$ and returns a total concept $\hat h:\mathcal X\to\{-1,+1\}$ satisfying $\text{er}_{\mathcal D}(\hat h)\leq \min_{h\in\mathcal H}\text{er}_{\mathcal D}(h)+\varepsilon$ with probability at least $1-\delta$, where $\text{er}_{\mathcal D}(h)=\mathbb P_{(x,y)\sim\mathcal D}[h(x)\neq y]$. This establishes the optimal sample complexity, matching the lower bound of Alon et al. (FOCS 2021).

translated_title: 部分概念类不可知PAC学习的最优样本复杂度
translated_abstract: 设 $\mathcal H\subseteq\{-1,+1,\star\}^{\mathcal X}$ 为具有有限VC维数 $d$ 的部分概念类。我们构造了一个确定性的不可知PAC学习器，对于任意 $\varepsilon,\delta\in(0,1)$，它使用从 $\mathcal X\times\{-1,+1\}$ 上任意分布 $\mathcal D$ 中抽取的 $O((d+\log(1/\delta))/\varepsilon^2)$ 个独立同分布样本，并返回一个全定义概念 $\hat h:\mathcal X\to\{-1,+1\}$，使得 $\text{er}_{\mathcal D}(\hat h)\leq \min_{h\in\mathcal H}\text{er}_{\mathcal D}(h)+\varepsilon$ 以至少 $1-\delta$ 的概率成立，其中 $\text{er}_{\mathcal D}(h)=\mathbb P_{(x,y)\sim\mathcal D}[h(x)\neq y]$。这一结果确立了最优样本复杂度，与Alon等人（FOCS 2021）的下界相匹配。
tldr: 该论文为VC维为d的部分概念类构造了一个确定性不可知PAC学习器，仅用 $O((d+\log(1/\delta))/\varepsilon^2)$ 个样本即可实现学习，样本复杂度与Alon等人（FOCS 2021）的下界匹配，达到最优。
en_tdlr: This paper constructs a deterministic agnostic PAC learner for partial concept classes of VC dimension d that uses O((d+log(1/δ))/ε²) samples, establishing the optimal sample complexity matching the lower bound of Alon et al. (FOCS 2021).
